## Position

**PhD Student** — Uppsala University, Department of Business Studies (2026 – )\
Member of the *Uppsala Patent History Group*, researching technological evolution in Sweden.

## Prior Positions

**Systems Developer** — Lund University, Department of Art and Cultural Sciences (2023 – 2026)

**Research Engineer** — Lund University, *DigitalHistory@Lund*, Department of Media and Communication (2021 – 2023)\
Interdepartmental research platform for digital history at Lund: supporting projects with data collection, cleaning and analysis; helping prepare grant applications; and running skills-training workshops and drop-in sessions for researchers.

**Research Assistant** — Lund University, *Experimentally Organised Economy*, CIRCLE (2020 – 2021)

**Research Assistant** — Lund University, *SWINNO*, Department of Economic History (2015 – 2018)\
The SWINNO database of Swedish innovations from 1970 to the present (with a historical extension back to 1889), together with a series of research projects on the Swedish innovation system that draw on it.

## Selected Projects

**Uppsala Patent History Group** — Uppsala University, 2026 –. Research on the business, economics and history of technology and innovation using detailed historical intellectual property data; developing the Swedish Historical Patents Infrastructure.

**Contentious Gatherings** — Lund University, VR-funded, 2024 – 2027. Repertoires of contention and democratisation in Sweden, 1820 – 1939, through public meetings, election meetings, and demonstration marches.

**Modern Times 1936** — Lund University, 2023 – 2025. Multimodal AI analysis of Swedish newsreels — what software sees, hears and perceives when pattern recognition meets media-historical sources.

**JADB — Job Ads Database** — Lund University, 2024 –. A new labour-market resource built from digitised Swedish newspapers, supporting historical research on recruitment and occupations.

## Software

**sca** — Python + SQLite implementation of *Structural Collocation Analysis*. `github.com/mathjoha/sca`

**SweScribe** — Automatic speech recognition for Swedish newsreels. `github.com/mathjoha/swescribe`

**kb-trend** — Trendline extraction from the National Library of Sweden search API (Python package + web app). `github.com/DigitalHistory-Lund/kb-trend`
